programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Following the Scottish West Coast with "Waverley"
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area; it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii - The Island of Oahu
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won’t find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy’s Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: Secrets of the North Sea
programme.desc: The North Sea is enigmatic. It presents itself in cool shades of grey. Yet who would have guessed that beneath the chilly waves are opulent coral gardens, courting squids, and several of the largest sea creatures on the planet?

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: mareTV: Jersey - Sunshine Island in the English Channel
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures - Iceland Extreme
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Money Makin' Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey
programme.desc: Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Abbi saa viimein mahdollisuuden valmentaa asiakasta Soulsticessa, ja Ilana uppoutuu uuteen rooliin riistokapitalistina.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbilta poistetaan viisaudenhampaat, ja Ilana omistautuu ystävänsä hoivaamiselle - mikä tarkoittaa tietysti huumecocktailia ja heitteillejättöä.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi ja Jeremy pääsevät vihdoin tositoimiin ja Abbi saa yllätyksen. Ilana koluaa sillä aikaa äitinsä kanssa New Yorkin alamaailmaa käsilaukkujen toivossa.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Ilanan paitsi jäämisen pelko saa tytöt metsästämään täydellisiä bileitä. Abbista paljastuu jännittävä, surrealistinen salaisuus, joka jättää Ilanan sanattomaksi.

programme.title: Broad City: The Matrix
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana toteavat olevansa netin orjia ja päättävät irrottautua verkosta päiväksi. Rullaluistelu, koirahäät ja hätätilanne saavat tytöt kuitenkin kaipaamaan älypuhelimiaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Porukka juhlii Jaimen uutta kansalaisuutta veneellä. Bevers johdattaa Abbin ja Ilanan ansaan lupauksilla ilmaisesta viinasta, joten Lincoln ja Jaime jäävät kahden yrityslakimiesten keskelle.

programme.title: Broad City: Kirk Steele
programme.desc: Abbi saa selville salaisuuden Treyn menneisyydestä ja käyttää tietoa hyväkseen työpaikalla. Ilana jakaa viisauttaan seuraavalle sukupolvelle.

programme.title: Broad City: Coat Check
programme.desc: Abbi ottaa asiakseen palauttaa julkkisihastuksensa takin. Ilana ihastuu tyttöön, jossa on jotain ihmeen tuttua.

programme.title: Broad City: St. Mark's
programme.desc: Ilanan 23-vuotissynttärijuhlat eivät ota onnistuakseen, ja tytöt päätyvät jahtaamaan ärsyttävää laukkuvarasta pitkin St. Mark's Placea.

programme.title: Broad City: Two Chainz
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana kohtaavat suuren vaatekriisin matkallaan ystävänsä taidenäyttelyyn. Samalla he etsivät epätoivoisesti yleistä vessaa.

programme.title: Broad City: Co-Op
programme.desc: Abbi esittää Ilanaa, koska tämä ei pääse suorittamaan työvuoroaan kommuunikaupassa. Ilana menee erittäin tärkeälle lääkärin vastaanotolle.

programme.title: Broad City: Game Over
programme.desc: Ilana saa uuden tilaisuuden loistaa työpaikallaan, ja Abbi yrittää hillitä kilpailuviettiään oman työpaikkansa kisailupäivänä.

programme.title: Broad City: Rat Pack
programme.desc: Jaime ja Ilana järjestävät maksulliset juhlat saadakseen takaisin tuholaistorjujalle maksamansa rotantapporajat. Abbi tahtoo tutustua uusiin ihmisiin.

programme.title: Broad City: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana matkaavat Philadelphiaan käymään Abbin lapsuudenkodissa. Abbi tajuaa mokanneensa lukioaikana pahasti, joten he lähtevät sovitusretkelle.

programme.title: Broad City: B&B-NYC
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana laittavat molemmat asuntonsa vuokralle tienatakseen hieman ylimääräistä taskurahaa.

programme.title: Broad City: Burning Bridges
programme.desc: Ilanan vanhemmat tulevat kaupunkiin juhlistamaan hääpäiväänsä, mutta parisuhdeongelmista kärsivät Abbi ja Ilana eivät ole juhlatuulella.

programme.title: Broad City: 2016
programme.desc: Ilana löytää uuden kutsumuksensa, ja Abbin pitää kohdata pelkonsa ja mennä uusimaan ajokorttinsa.

programme.title: Broad City: Getting There
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana ovat lähdössä matkalle, mutta lentoasemalle pääsy osoittautuu yllättävän hankalaksi suoritukseksi.

programme.title: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
programme.desc: Abbin kuukautiset alkavat kesken lennon, ja hän aloittaa Ilanan kanssa epätoivoisen tamponin etsinnän.

programme.title: Broad City: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana tapaavat ensimmäistä kertaa keväisenä päivänä vuonna 2011.

programme.title: Broad City: Twaining Day
programme.desc: Abbin pikavisiitti Soulsticessa muuttuu mielenkiintoiseksi, kun hänelle avautuu unelmien valmennusmahdollisuus. Sillä välin Ilana saa uuden työpaikan eräästä ravintolasta.

programme.title: Broad City: Just the Tips
programme.desc: Ilana innostuu tuhlaamaan tienestejään, ja Abbi paistattelee uuden parisuhteen loistossa. Myöhemmin juhlissa tytöt törmäävät erääseen vanhaan ystäväänsä.

programme.title: Broad City: Mushrooms
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana syövät taikasieniä ja päätyvät tapahtumarikkaalle tripille.

programme.title: Broad City: Abbi's Mom
programme.desc: Abbin äiti saapuu kaupunkiin, ja Ilana yrittää selviytyä Sushi Mambeaux'n työkulttuurista kaamosmasennuksen kourissa.

programme.title: Broad City: Witches
programme.desc: Abbi tuntee itsensä vanhaksi löydettyään harmaan hiuksen. Ilana käy seksiterapeutilla.

programme.title: Broad City: Florida
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Eliot ja Bobbi matkustavat Floridaan siivoamaan Esther-mummin asuntoa.

programme.title: Broad City: House Sitting
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Jaime ja Lincoln ovat kotivahtina. Ilana ja Lincoln määrittelevät suhteensa, ja Abbi tapaa erään miehen menneisyydestä.

programme.title: Broad City: Bed Bugs
programme.desc: Uusi, kaunis laukku kohottaa Abbin itsetuntoa työttömyyden keskellä. Ilana ja Jaimé kohtaavat painajaisen, jolta New Yorkissa ei voi välttyä.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Tyttöjen ystävyysvuosipäivän juhlinta saa vaarallisen käänteen, kun he todistavat jotain karmaisevaa.

programme.title: Broad City: Stories
programme.desc: Juhlistaakseen Abbin 30-vuotissyntymäpäivää Abbi ja Ilana matkustavat läpi Manhattanin ja törmäävät matkalla sekä vanhoihin että uusiin ystäviin.

programme.title: Broad City: SheWork and S**t Bucket
programme.desc: Ilana yrittää tienata rahaa tällä kertaa perustamalla New Yorkin tupakoitsijoille ulkona sijaitsevan työtilan. Abbi ei hyväksy vuokranantajansa päätöstä kieltäytyä uusimasta asunnon putkistoa.

programme.title: Broad City: Bitcoin & the Missing Girl
programme.desc: Ilana vierailee vanhan heilansa luona ja vaatii tältä omaa Bitcoin-osuuttaan. Abbi vie pyykkinsä ensimmäistä kertaa pesulaan ja menettää suosikkipuseronsa.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Kohti Suurta Suolajärveä
programme.desc: Akselin ja Ossin pekoninhuuruinen road trip kohti itää jatkuu uusissa osavaltioissa. Idaho saa pitää perunansa, sillä Utahissa odottavat kaikkien aikojen hodari-överit!

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Kalliovuorten kuninkaat
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi testaavat off road -taitojaan ja tekevät valtiovierailun miljardöörien Aspeniin. Kalliovuorten jälkeen grillataan ja heilutellaan melaa Coloradon koskissa.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Hot Rodeja ja biisonipihvejä
programme.desc: Mikään ei hidasta burgerimiehiä, paitsi Hot Rod -festivaalit, Miss Pin up -kisat ja liian pienet hevoset! Horisontissa näkyy jo Texas, mutta sitä ennen käydään biisoniranchilla.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Tykypäivät Texasissa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi kutsutaan Dallas Starsin NHL-treeneihin puhumaan oikeasta ravinnosta. Tankkauksen kanssa ei leikitä, sillä Markkasen Laurikin on kaupungissa. Mutta missä on JJ?

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Rajakaupungin rosvot
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi herättävät kauhua golf-kentällä ja syövät enemmän tacoja kuin Texasin laki sallii. Raja tulee lopulta vastaan ja pakoautoa on vaihdettava. Arkansas, hoi! Täältä tullaan!

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Kovaa virtaa Mississippi!
programme.desc: Amerikan halki iskevät Burgerimiehet käyvät Arkansasissa pitsalla, burgerilla, pastalla ja kylvyssä. Matka jatkuu pää märkänä Memphisiin onkimaan Tennesseen tuoreinta kissakalaa.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Sweet home Alabama ja Nashville, Tennessee
programme.sub-title: Sweet home Alabama ja Nashville, Tennessee
programme.desc: Mestarileipurit Akseli ja Ossi vaivaavat Alabamassa. Kun munkit on nähty, siirrytään naapuripitäjän puolelle Nashvilleen Mikael Granlundin ravintoterapeuteiksi.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Viimeiset burgerit
programme.desc: Akseli Herlevi ja Ossi Lahtinen lähestyvät Atlantin valtamerta. Matkaa on takana tuhansia maileja ja edessä enää yksi osavaltio, vieraanvaraisuudestaan kuuluisa Georgia. Kausi päättyy.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Kaukoidän kutsu
programme.desc: Uusi kausi alkaa! Burgerimiehet Akseli Herlevi ja Ossi Lahtinen singahtavat Aasian kiertueelle uusien street food-herkkujen perässä. Karavaani starttaa Japanin pääkaupungista Tokiosta. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Isona Japanissa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi ottavat haltuun Japanin keisarillisen Kioton teeseremonian kautta. Kimonot lepattavat, ramen roihuaa, munakasta menee ja luotijuna laulaa, kun Burgerimiesten Aasian kiertue jatkuu. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Samuraiden kosto
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi paljastavat miekkansa Japanin Osakassa. Hodariympyrä sulkeutuu ja nyytit käyvät tulikuumina, kun burgerimiehet saavat syntymäpäivävieraan japanilaisen kulttuurin huipulta. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Sakeaa menoa Kobessa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi maistelevat sake-panimon tyhjäksi ja syövät Koben härät. Varpusparvi haastaa Ossia, mutta periksi ei anneta. Viimeinen juhla-ateria Japanissa vedetään tappiin asti. Kotimainen ruokareality. (41')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Pöytä Koreaksi
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi iskevät ginsengin voimalla Korean BBQ:n kimppuun Etelä-Korean Busanissa. Ikonisesta mummotunnelista löydetään mahtavat herkut ja tilaisuudesta otetaan vaari lasillisella sojua. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Soulin sankarit
programme.desc: K-pop veteraanit Akseli ja Ossi kutsutaan valtiovierailulle Etelä-Korean pääkaupunkiin Souliin. Ohjelmaan kuuluu kanalan tyhjennys, Aasian hitain munaleipä ja laiton jokiristeily. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Phukettimatka Thaimaassa
programme.desc: Uhanalaiset thaimaannorpat Akseli ja Ossi saapuvat pakettimatkalle Phuketiin. Pakettiin kuuluu banaanilettujen lisäksi runsaasti lihaa, kalaa ja kasviksia sekä normaalit ruokajuomat. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Monta yötä Bangkokissa
programme.desc: Burgerimiehet Akseli ja Ossi raivaavat tiensä läpi Bangkokin öisten kujien. Kaikki syödään mitä vastaan tulee, mukaan lukien sonninjormakeitto, naudan ikenet ja peräkärryllinen chiliä. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Hyvää huomenta Vietnam!
programme.desc: Burgerimiehet Akseli ja Ossi vetävät keittoa Vietnamissa niin innokkaasti että joutuvat Saigonille. Riisinhallinta onnistuu ja perinteinen vietnamilainen munakahvi piristää! Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Sokka irti Singaporessa
programme.desc: Burgerimiesten Aasian kiertue huipentuu Singaporeen, jossa ajetaan tandemilla päätyyn asti. Matkaoppaana toimii Singapore Sling ja listalta valitaan kaikki kertaa kaikki. Sarja päättyy. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Säpinää Seattlessa
programme.desc: Uusi kausi alkaa! Burgerimiehet Akseli Herlevi ja Ossi Lahtinen jyräävät Amerikan halki uusien street food -herkkujen perässä. Eeppinen reissu käynnistyy Tyynen meren rannalta Seattlesta.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Pöhinää Portlandissa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi taistelevat villien tonnikalojen kanssa ja iskevät Oregonin street food skeneen kuin miljoona volttia. Mikään ei pysäytä burgerimiehiä, paitsi nälkä ja jano!

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)
programme.sub-title: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)
programme.desc: On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Key to the Enigma (Farid Ouzzane Case)
programme.sub-title: The Key to the Enigma (Farid Ouzzane Case)
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man. In order to identify this unknown man, whose face was unrecognizable.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.sub-title: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Audrey Jouannet Case
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell Case
programme.sub-title: The Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell Case
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains. Taken to hospital, the couple die several days apart. The food poisoning theory is quickly ruled out and forensic tests show the Labrells were poisoned with arsenic.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Nelly Crémel Case
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Willy Pomonti Case
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Adeline Piet Case
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! What has happened to Adeline Piet?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and –an extra sordid detail – a devil mask is found next to her body.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mathilde Croguenne Case

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Tight Leash
programme.desc: How did the stalker obtain the security system code for his victim's home? How did he steal her personal photographs? Police needed answers and they found them in the most unlikely of places.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skirting the Evidence
programme.desc: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Step by Step
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Blanket of Evidence
programme.desc: In 1997, Kelly Eckart's car was found, with her belongings still in it, after she worked a late shift in Franklin, Indiana. Days later, her body was found in an isolated ravine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Two in a Million
programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insulated Evidence
programme.desc: It's usually easy to determine how a criminal entered the crime scene. But in this case, it looked as if the killer vanished into thin air ? and perhaps he had.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Day the Music Died
programme.desc: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of grunge singer Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the "dirt" on her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Finger Pane
programme.desc: A serial killer was on the loose and police had to find him before he struck again. Their most promising lead was an unusual one: a bloody fingerprint on the body of one of the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Good as Gold
programme.desc: On Halloween night 2004, Adriane Insogna and Leslie Mazzara were brutally murdered in their Napa, California home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Innocence
programme.desc: This killer probably hoped to cover his tracks by staging the crime scene. But investigators saw through the attempt almost immediately and turned to forensic science to learn what really happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Butt Certain
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Disrobed
programme.desc: The crime scene was especially violent: a husband and wife had been shot to death in their bedroom. Was their 16-year-old daughter complicit?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: About Face

programme.title: Freaks and Geeks FI: Girlfriends And Boyfriends
programme.desc: Lindsay tajuaa Nickin olevan nyt poikaystävänsä ja pelkää tämän haluavan seksiä. Sam on toiveikas Cindy Sandersin suhteen. Molemmat Weirit huomaavat, ettei kaikki ole sitä, miltä näyttää.

programme.desc: Bill janoaa tunnustusta liikuntatunneilla. Harold ja Jean pitävät Kimiä huonona seurana tyttärelleen ja kieltävät Lindsayta tapaamasta ystäväänsä.

programme.title: Freaks and Geeks FI: Looks And Books
programme.desc: Lindsayn suhde friikkeihin ajautuu kriisiin. Sam kehittää itseään – ulkoisesti

programme.desc: Lindsay pelkää, että Nick pysyy ikuisesti pilvessä. Kiusaaja Alan tekee Billille jekun, ja seuraukset ovat lähes kohtalokkaat.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Oceanin ystävä Reuben Tishkoff joutuu julman petoksen uhriksi. Kyse ei ole rahasta. Tällä kertaa rikos tehdään henkilökohtaisin perustein.

programme.title: Naked Attraction Suomi
programme.desc: Sukupuoliroolit romukoppaan. Kuvataiteilija Tonya viehättyy ihan kaikenlaisista ihmisistä - miehistä, naisista, transihmisistä ja muunsukupuolisista. Tonyaa kiehtoo androgyynisyys ja sukupuolirooleilla leikkiminen. Alastomuus on Tonyalle luontevaa ja paitsi että hän hengailee kotonaan alasti, riisuutuu hän myös välillä performanssitaideteoksissaan. Toisessa ihmisessä kiinnostavaa ovat tatuoinnit, lävistykset ja karvaisuus. Paljastuukohan kopeista ihmisiä, joilla on näitä ominaisuuksia? Suomi 2023

programme.title: Naked Attraction Suomi
programme.desc: Pitkän parisuhteen jälkeen sinkkumarkkinoille. Sairaanhoitaja Riitalla on takanaan pitkä parisuhde ja nyt parin vuoden sinkkuuden jälkeen aika alkaa tuntua otolliselta uudelle kumppanille. Viimeksi, kun Riitta oli sinkkumarkkinoilla, kommunikointi tapahtui sovellusten sijaan tekstiviesteillä ja kotisohvalla svaippailun sijaan seuraa etsittiin baareista. Koska nykypäivän deittailukulttuuri tuntuu vieraalta, Riitta on tullut selvittämään, löytyisikö uusi kumppani Naked Attraction -studion värikkäistä kopeista. Riitan silmää miellyttää pitkä mies, jolla on tuikkivat silmät ja voimakkaat käsivarret. Löytyykö unelmien mies kopista ja mitä kummaa mahtaa olla kisuaminen? Suomi 2023

"Järkyttävät otokset kidnappauksista, murroista, autojen hurjista takaa-ajoista ja muista rikoksista saavat miljoonia katsojia, mutta rikosten takana olevia tarinoita ei ole kerrottu ennen kuin nyt. programme.title: Suomen huutokauppakeisari

programme.desc: Mustasukkaisuutta ja rappia. Nuori mies etsii paikkaansa nuoren naisen viereltä, mutta kuinka toimia, kun nainen ei pysy paikallaan?

programme.desc: Joulu tulee jopa autokauppaan, missä asiakas ei osaa päättää ostaako yhden vai kaksi autoa. Myyjä taas ei osaa päättää onko asiakas ostaja vai huijari. Kello käy ja kinkku odottaa kotona, mutta asiakas on aina oikeassa...

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Intohimoisen kalamiehen reissu kääntyy ylösalaisin kuin vene koskessa. Maailma ja avioliitto kaatuvat, mutta se suurin on vielä pyydystämättä.

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Korona ja politiikka ovat lennonjohtajien intohimojen hämärät kohteet. Läheltä piti -tilanteita sattuu myös ihmissuhteissa ilmassa niitä ei huomaa. Kun oikein pännii, niin lakko auttaa.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Veksi ostaa lapsenlapselleen ylioppilaslahjaa ja -lakkia, Stokkalta tietenkin. Vaan mitä neuvoksi, kun onnenkalun hattukoko ei olekaan isoisällä handussa? Onneksi palvelu pelaa myös hätätilanteessa!

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Fjalle unohtaa vetää kellonsa ja myöhästyy tapaamiselta, mutta onneksi parivaljakko on kuitenkin ajoissa Veksin sukulaistytön ylioppilasjuhlissa, jonne on oikein pynttäydyttykin. Tilanne herkistääkin isoisää poikkeuksellisen paljon.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Matka itäkeskukseen metrolla on pojille sen verran eksoottinen yhdistelmä, ettei reissusta taida tulla mitään. Kätevästi juna kuitenkin löytyy Rautatieasemalta, ja perille päästään - tai ainakin päästään jonnekin. Vierailevana tähtenä Mikko Kivinen.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Seikkailu "Itäkeskuksessa" jatkuukin niin pitkäksi, että pojat päätyvät yöpymään hotellissa Tammisaaressa. Samalla myös paikallisten villit avioitumisriitit tulevat tutuiksi, ja saadaanhan se takkikin lopulta korjattua.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Veksi-isoisä esittelee lapsenlapselleen Korkeasaaren ihmeitä, ja Fjalle-kamu on luonnollisesti menossa mukana. Lajien tunnistus ei vain aina tahdo sujua ihan kaikkien luonnontieteen oppien mukaan. Ja miten niitä sääntöjen rikkojia voi olla Korkeasaaressak

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Kun Veksin ja Fjallen korviin kantautuu työkeikalla, että tuttua kukkakauppaa uhkaa sulkeminen, on pakko tietenkin piipahtaa paikalla ja kohdata totuus omin silmin. Ja samallahan herrasmiehet luonnollisesti hankkivat daameilleen kukkakimput.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Veksi ja Fjalle lähtevät puolisoineen landelle kesää viettämään, vaikka Humallahti tai Oulunkyläkin varmaan jo riittäisi. Ulkohuussi hämmentää ja pelottaa, mutta onneksi tikanheitto ja kalastus ovat tuttua huttua stadilaisillekin.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Fjallella ja Britalla tulee 37 vuotta auvoista avioelämää täyteen, ja kyllähän sellaista merkkipäivää kannattaa viettää jo vähän juhlallisemmissa tunnelmissa. Samalla ajan vääjäämätön virta pistää pojat miettimään iän tuomia ongelmia.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Fjallen sairaalareissu saa Veksin muistelemaan menneitä tavallistakin ponnekkaammin. Muisteloissa käydään läpi muun muassa Veksin hääpäivä, josta ei dramatiikkaa puuttunut. Nykypäivässä huoli ja murhe parhaasta kaverista on kova.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Korkeasaaren lautan tarpeettoman heiluva käynti ärsyttää poikia niin, että asiasta päätetään kirjelmöidä ihan kaupungin pormestarille asti. Ja kun Fjalle ja Veksi ovat asialla, pormestarihan täytyy luonnollisesti päästä tapaamaan ihan henkilökohtaisesti.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Joulu lähestyy jo uhkaavasti Stadiakin, mutta onneksi Fjalle lupaa hankkia sellaisen kuusen, että porukalta lähtee jalat alta. Kuusikaupoilla pitääkin olla varuillaan, ettei joudu huijatuksi.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Stadilaisen jouluun kuuluu tietenkin rentouttava saunominen Harjutorin saunassa, mutta Veksiä jännittää silti kovasti illalla odottava joulupukkikeikka. Onneksi vanhalla nyrkkeilijällä on paras mahdollinen tsemppaaja ja ystävä, nimittäin Fjalle.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Lyin' Hearted
programme.desc: Sydänleikkaukseen valmistautuva Arthur pyytää Carrieta ja Dougia hakemaan hänen unimaskinsa. Maskia etsiessään Carrie tekee mielenkiintoisia löytöjä. Doug tutustuu sairaalassa omituiseen vieraaseen ja saa pian katua sitä.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Life Sentence
programme.desc: Kun Carrie ehdottaa henkivakuutusta, Doug huolestuu, että Carrie saattaa kuolla ja jättää hänet hoitamaan Arthuria. Deacon, Spence ja Danny keksivät viihdettä katsomalla Arthurin arkisia toimia Dougin asentaman kameran kautta.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Veiled Threat
programme.desc: Hääkakku saa Carrien muistelemaan hänen ja Dougin hääpäivää, jolloin hän etsi epätoivoisesti merkkiä siitä, että hän ja Doug kuuluvat yhteen.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Oxy Moron
programme.desc: Carrie suivaantuu, kun Doug panee lentokoneen happinaamarin itselleen ennen hänen auttamistaan. Spence etsii uutta asuntoa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Depo Man
programme.desc: Doug joutuu todistajaksi Carrien pomon hoitamassa tapauksessa. Danny ja Spence kiistelevät Hollysta.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Ovary Action
programme.desc: Dougin vanhempien jouluvierailu häiritsee hänen ja Carrien yritystä saattaa raskaus alulleen Carrien hedelmällisenä aikana.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Food Fight
programme.desc: Carrie tulee mustasukkaiseksi, kun Doug keskittyy Spencen uuteen tyttöystävään Beckyyn, joka on ammattilaiskokki.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Double Downer
programme.desc: Carrie ja Doug lähtevät Atlantic Cityyn Deaconin järjestämälle ryhmämatkalle, mutta ainoa toinen paikalle ilmaantuva on Dougin pomo O'Boyle.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Dougie Nights
programme.desc: Doug yrittää saada Deaconin ajattelemaan muutakin kuin Kellyä ja tajuaa kaipaavansa sinkkuelämää. Carrie kokee asemansa uhatuksi, kun firmaan tulee uusi toimistoavustaja, Lila, joka näyttää hämmästyttävän paljon häneltä.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: No Orleans
programme.desc: Doug ja Carrie löytävät kymmenen vuotta vanhan 1500 dollarin sekin vanhan häälahjan sisältä ja toivovat saavansa uuden sekin päästäkseen matkalle New Orleansiin. Arthur yrittää saada pilapiirroksensa julkaistua Playboyssa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Missing Links
programme.desc: Carrie ei pidä tytöstä, jonka Deacon tuo hänen firmansa golf-retkelle. Deacon pyytää Hollyn lapsenvahdiksi tajuamatta, että tämä on ihastunut häneen.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Hero Worship
programme.desc: Doug unelmoi vakavissaan oman voileipäpuotinsa perustamisesta sen jälkeen, kun Stu-setä tarjoaa hänelle avokätisen summan, jolla hän voisi toteuttaa haaveensa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Screwed Driver
programme.desc: Carrien liikematkan aikana Dougin vanhemmat tulevat kylään ja valtaavat talon, mikä saa Dougin tuntemaan itsensä taas lapseksi. Arthur yrittää rikastua keksimällä uudenlaisen ruuvimeisselin, jonka hän nimeää itsensä mukaan.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Lush Life
programme.desc: Carrien uusi työnjälkeinen rutiini, joka sisältää omenamartineja ja rennomman asenteen, tulee yhtäkkiä päätökseensä. Doug ja Arthur yhdistävät voimansa pitääkseen Carrien juovuksissa, mitä Lou ei hyväksy.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Bun Dummy
programme.desc: Lukiotapaamisensa lähestyessä Doug pelkää, että Carrien uusi kampaus saa tämän näyttämään kirjastonhoitajalta eikä tavallisen seksikkäältä.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Patrons Ain't
programme.desc: Kun Heffernanit tajuavat, että heidän pitäisi antaa enemmän hyväntekeväisyyteen, kiltti ele kääntyy tunnustuksen havitteluksi.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Eddie Money
programme.desc: Carrien kiellosta huolimatta Doug ottaa satasen hätärahastosta lyödäkseen vetoa nyrkkeilyottelussa. Kun hän ja Deacon voittavat 5000 dollaria, Doug tajuaa, ettei voi kertoa voitostaan Carrielle, koska se paljastaisi hänen varastaneen rahat.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Shrink Wrap
programme.desc: Arthur vierailee psykiatrin luona ja kokee takauman epämiellyttävästä kohtaamisesta isänsä kanssa, joka saattaa tarjota selityksen Arthurin ätäkkään persoonallisuuteen.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Two Thirty
programme.desc: Doug uskoo, että hänen uusi hammaslääkärinsä, joka oli aikoinaan ihastunut Carrieen, tekee hänelle tahallaan kipeää.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Window Pain
programme.desc: Carrie tuntee itsensä naapureiden vähättelemäksi ja yrittää tehdä hyvän vaikutuksen, mutta Dougia moinen ei kiinnosta tippaakaan. Arthur yrittää hyödyntää Spenceä päästäkseen metrolla ilmaiseksi.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Arthur, Spooner
programme.desc: Kun Carrie on väliaikaisesti yövuorossa, Doug hakee seuraa Arthurista ja alkaa lämmetä tälle.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Kirbed Enthusiasm
programme.desc: Deacon pyytää Dougilta apua Kirbyn jalkapallojoukkueen valmentamisessa, ja poika haastaa Dougin hakemaan puoliammattilaiseen joukkueeseen. Ajatus ei miellytä Carrieta, kunnes hän näkee Dougista mielenkiintoisen kuvan.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Holy Mackerel
programme.desc: Doug ja Carrie törmäävät pastoriinsa ja suostuvat paineen alla menemään kirkkoon. Arthur ottaa vastaan ostotarjouksia talosta, vaikka se ei olekaan hänen myytävänään.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Jung Frankenstein
programme.desc: Carrien mielestä Doug tarvitsee ammattilaisapua huonojen syömätapojensa hillitsemiseksi, joten hän taivuttelee Dougin terapiaan. Nähtyään Dougin edistyvän Carrie pyytää terapeuttia työstämään Dougin muita ongelmia.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Mammary Lane
programme.desc: Dougin keilajoukkue valmistautuu kilpailuun, ja Carrie suostuu vahtimaan herra Kaplanin poikaa urallaan etenemisen toivossa. Mutta kun Doug päättää flirttailla säälistä ja Carrie törmää vääriin käsiin, kaikki menee mönkään.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Business Affairs
programme.desc: Doug poikkeaa Carrien työpaikalla ja tapaa hänen työsiippansa Curtin. Carrie vakuuttaa, että Curt on gay eikä Dougilla ole syytä huoleen, mutta heidän läheisyytensä saa hänen olonsa uhatuksi.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Flash Photography
programme.desc: Doug ottaa häissä ronskin valokuvan hääparin antamalla kertakäyttökameralla. Hän antaa Dannyn saada syyt niskoilleen, mutta papille tunnustettuaan hänen täytyy tarttua härkää sarvista ja kertoa totuus.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Flame Resistant
programme.desc: Doug ja Carrie törmäävät Dougin lempibaarissa Dougin lukioaikaiseen tyttöystävään, Margieen

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Connect Four
programme.desc: Carrie voittaa neljä lippua Knicksin peliin, mutta haluaa mukaan toisen pariskunnan Dougin kavereiden sijaan. Arthur joutuu vaikeuksiin väittämällä, että hän osaa "hoitaa" parkkisakot pois.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Mentalo Case
programme.desc: Lapsuuden lelu saa Deaconin ja Dougin riitaantumaan.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Loaner Car
programme.desc: Doug lainaa Carrien Deaconille auttamaan kiitospäiväaterian laittamisessa. Kun Deacon vaihtaa Carrien Hollyn ruoanlaittoapuun, hän sotkeutuu valheisiinsa. Asiaa salaillessaan Doug kaivaa itselleen hautaa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Golden Moldy
programme.desc: Doug ja Carrie nauttivat lomastaan St. Croix'ssa naapureidensa kanssa, mutta hauskanpito tyssää, kun Arthur soittaa ja kertoo, mitä talon homeongelman korjaaminen maksaa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: S'Poor House
programme.desc: Heffernanien talon homeongelma pahenee, ja Doug ja Carrie kuulevat ongelman korjaamisen maksavan 12 000 dollaria!

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Attention Deficit
programme.desc: Doug saa pakkomielteen Super Bowl -juhlistaan kuultuaan, että monet hänen kavereistaan ovatkin menossa uuden työtoverin juhliin.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Steve Moscow
programme.desc: Doug ja Carrie turvautuvat äärimmäisiin keinoihin ja yrittävät saada venäläisen remonttiporukan korjaamaan heidän talonsa antamalla miehille vodkaa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Animal Attraction
programme.desc: Doug ei voi olla ystävänpäivänä Carrien kanssa, koska hänen ja Deaconin täytyy kuljettaa pingviinejä eläintarhasta toiseen. Carrie ja Holly lähtevät ulos, ja Carrie antaa Hollylle vinkkejä miehen saantiin.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Prints Charming
programme.desc: Doug ja Carrie saavat vahingossa toisen pariskunnan valokuvat. Kuvia katsoessaan he tajuavat, että heidän elämänsä ei ole yhtä hyvää kuin niiden toisten, joten he ottavat valokuvista esimerkkiä.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Cowardly Lyin'
programme.desc: Carrie saa pääsyliput oopperaan, mutta Doug pyytää Deaconia valehtelemaan, jotta ei joutuisi menemään. Carrie kuitenkin saa hänet kiinni valheesta, mikä saa Dougin tunnustamaan muitakin valheita.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Queens'bro Bridge
programme.desc: Arthur ja hänen velipuolensa Skitch tapaavat, kun Doug järjestää heille kohtaamisen Skitchin miehittämällä tiemaksuasemalla.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Driving Reign
programme.desc: Danny pyytää Dougilta suosituskirjettä päästäkseen IPS:llä kuskiksi. Ajatus ei miellytä Dougia, joten Carrie päättää kirjoittaa kirjeen, jonka Doug allekirjoittaa.

programme.desc: Doug ei suostu antamaan periksi, kun Carrie inhoaa hänen uutta partavettään. Arthur opettaa Hollyn ja Spencen livahtamaan elokuviin.

programme.desc: Carrien epäilyksistä huolimatta Doug toteuttaa vanhan unelmansa baarimikoksi ryhtymisestä, mutta pian hän tajuaa, ettei se ole samanlaista kuin elokuvassa "Cocktail." Arthur hakee vanhuskeskuksen puheenjohtajaksi.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Deconstructing Carrie
programme.desc: Carrie on allapäin, koska tuntee kauneutensa haalistuvan 35-vuotispäivänsä lähestyessä, joten Doug järjestää rakennustyömaan miehet pönkittämään hänen itsetuntoaan. Arthur haluaa antaa Carrielle täydellisen lahjan.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Catching Hell

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Wish Boned
programme.desc: Doug voittaa matkan St. Louisiin koripallon loppukisoihin, ja Carrie taivuttelee hänet ottamaan Arthurin mukaan.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Slippery Slope
